extension.description:
Watch live channels, live events, replays and shows from your Kayo Sports subscription.
Subscription required. Requires script.module.slyguy (installed automatically from the NERV Repository) and Kodi 20 or newer.
extension.news:
v1.2.1 - Fix "Widevine license request failed" on devices with a software Widevine CDM (Linux, Windows, macOS)
v1.2.0 - Resume a live event from where you stopped watching, alongside Join Live and From Start
v1.1.0 - Choose Join Live or From Start when playing a live event that has already started
v1.0.0 - Initial release for the DAZN-based Kayo platform
